Your prompts keep working while you sleep

Pick a chat, a time and a prompt. PromptAlarm sends it for you and tries again until your usage limit resets.

Schedules History Settings

Everything stays in this browser. PromptAlarm has no account, no server and no tracking, and it never reads or stores the replies it sees.

PromptAlarm is not affiliated with Anthropic, OpenAI or Google. It only types the prompt you wrote and presses send, the way you would. It cannot get around a usage limit, and it cannot run while Chrome is closed or the computer is asleep. Check each service's terms before automating anything.

New schedule

Open the conversation, copy the address from the address bar, and paste it here.

When

Opens the chat link in the background and reads the time from the usage-limit notice. The site only shows that notice while a limit is active.

When a run finds the limit still active and the page says when it resets, the time of day above moves to match for the following days.

Prompt

Follow-ups are sent after the previous reply finishes. You can use {{date}}, {{time}} and {{runNumber}}. Keep prompts under a few thousand characters; very long text may turn into an attachment on some sites.

Retries and safety

Before you go to sleep

  • Keep Chrome open Runs only happen while Chrome is running. You can minimize it.
  • Keep the computer awake A sleeping computer cannot send anything.
  • Stay signed in Stay signed in to the chat site.
  • Try it once now Leave the message box empty, then send a test run.
